_help: Bonuses are percentages (attack/defense/cost) or flat amounts (move/range/vision), keyed by unit group: all, infantry (Rifleman, Bazooka, Sniper), vehicle (ground vehicles), air (aircraft), naval (ships), tank (Light/Heavy Tank), direct, indirect (Artillery, Rocket), or a unit id like scout. 'charge' is how much the power meter needs (damage dealt counts half, damage taken counts full, measured in unit value). 'heal' is HP restored to every unit when the power fires (10 = 1 HP).

power.name: Rally
power.description: All units +15% attack and defense, and heal 1 HP.

passive.description: Artillery and rockets +25% attack and +1 vision. Direct-fire units −5% attack.

power.name: Barrage
power.description: Artillery and rockets +1 range and another +25% attack.

passive.description: Infantry (Riflemen, Bazookas, Snipers) cost 15% less. Riflemen and Bazookas capture 20% faster.

power.name: Fortify
power.description: All units +30% defense and heal 1 HP.

passive.description: All units +1 vision and can see into forests. Scout Cars +1 movement and +20% attack.

power.name: Blackout
power.description: All units +10% attack and +1 movement. With fog of war on, reveals the whole map.
